entity_raw.definition_raw:
Your precise timing and smooth teamwork allow you to strike a foe where it hurts.

Prerequisite(s): Dex 13, Precise Strike, base attack bonus +4.

Benefit(s): Whenever you deal additional damage with Precise Strike, you also deal 1 point of bleed damage. This bleed damage does not stack with itself.
